messages:
erin: Heads up — console quota numbers look off for a subset of orgs after last night's client library releases. Saw a 30-40% drop in attributed tokens for some routes.
sam: Ugh. Which release? Py/TS/Go?
erin: TS 3.2.0 and py 1.14.0 rolled last night. The pattern looks like requests without a cost header are being grouped into the default bucket instead of the org bucket.
lily: Can you paste an example request/headers? might be a header name mismatch
erin: here's a sample from a repro trace:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
x-route-id: model/ggml
x-cost-center: team-frontend
```
But traces show the server saw `x-cost-center` missing and `x-costcenter` present in some hits.

sam: Oh — TS 3.2.0 changed header serialization to camelCase for backwards compat with fetch: `xCostCenter` -> client shipped `x-costcenter` (lowercased, no dash) when running through our gateway. py preserved dash-case.
ravi: That explains it. Our quota attribution rules only look for `x-cost-center` and `cost-center` and the new casing falls through to default attribution.
observability-bot: New anomaly detected: quota-attribution-mismatch spike starting 3420000300; affected orgs: 12; top routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat
lily: Is this strictly a client-side bug or should we patch the server to be more permissive? We have several customers using older clients and some using the new ones.
erin: Short term — we need to restore correct billing attribution for affected customers ASAP. Long term — define a negotiation for header normalization in the SDKs + server.

sam: Suggest immediate mitigation:
- deploy a server-side shim that normalizes header variants to `x-cost-center` (and `x-tenant-id`, `x-route-id`) during ingress parsing
- rollout a hotfix to TS SDK to revert the header transformation
- add an integration test to prevent regressions

ravi: +1 for shim. Server fix is safest and quick. But we should also add telemetry to measure how many clients send which variants.

lily: I'll own the TS hotfix and the SDK release notes. sam can you own the server shim? erin can you coordinate customer comms for the 12 affected orgs?

sam: I'll put a small nginx lua filter in front of the gateway to normalize headers and push a canary to prod (10%). If telemetry looks good, promote to 100%.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started by sam — ingress-shim v0.1 -> canary 10% (3420001500)

erin: For telemetry, we want a per-tenant count of header variants and the attribution result. observability-bot, can you add a dash tile for this under console -> quota diagnostics?

observability-bot: Added tile: "header-variant: quota attribution" to console diagnostics under a temp section. Data available in ~5m.

ravi: Also propose a small change to quota attribution logic: accept header variants `x-cost-center`, `x-costcenter`, `xCostCenter`, and `cost-center` and prefer the one with the highest confidence (explicit x- headers > body fields > defaults). We'll write a spec.

lily: For SDKs: we'll add an opt-in compatibility mode flag that preserves existing header formatting for customers who depend on it, and default to normalized dashed headers in the next major.

sam: Tests to add:
- e2e: header variants roundtrip through proxy -> attribution
- unit: normalization function covers mapping table
- load: ensure shim doesn't regress latency (target <3ms p95 extra)

erin: Timeline: shim canary -> 10:15, telemetry check 10:20, promote 10:30 if no regressions; TS hotfix patch release by EOD; console notes & customer outreach in parallel.

lily: Also adding a deprecation note in SDK changelog about default header formatting switch with clear migration steps.

ravi: I'll draft the server spec and PR today.

erin: thanks team. keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
